pages.title: Photochemical Reactor
pages.text: A quartz cell under an ultraviolet lamp: light, not heat, breaks the bonds.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the lamp's intensity and the cell's path length. The mixture must absorb between 90% and 99.9% of the light (absorbance A = εcl between 1 and 3): too thin and the light goes straight through; too thick and only a skin of the mixture by the window reacts. Brighter is faster, but above 400 W/m² the lamp cooks the cell.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 3 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Hydrogen, Hydrogen Cyanide, Tholin.
